payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of ecommerce specialists for customer Bruno Almeida, whose delivered stroller on order # is part of a newly announced safety recall. The customer provided a photo of the product serial label and a screenshot of the recall email. Reference entity IDs: customer id, order id #. MANDATORY steps: 1. identity_verifier must authenticate Bruno Almeida before any financial or return action, 2. order_specialist must inspect the delivered order and product details to verify the purchased variant matches the potentially affected recalled item, 3. knowledge_specialist must consult the exact recall-handling guidance and any customer-facing instructions for recalled baby gear, 4. refund_specialist must determine the permitted remedy path and issue the approved refund or store credit only if the recall criteria are met, 5. case_analyst must review and route the case if specialized recall operations handling is required, 6. commerce_ops_manager must summarize the final resolution and next steps.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- recall operations guidance rc 2025 0417: Internal recall-handling guidance specifying validation steps, permitted remedies, and when Recall Operations must own the case. Extracted content: Recall Operations Guidance RC 2025 0417 Internal recall-handling guidance specifying validation steps, permitted remedies, and when Recall Operations must own the case. Details Document Title Recall Operations Guidance Guidance Code RC-2025-0417 Effective Date 2025-04-17 purpose states that the document defines validation steps, permitted remedies, and ownership rules for recalled products identity verification is required before any refund, replacement, return authorization, or other financial action order review requires confirming the delivered order record and matching the product details against the customer-provided serial label customer-provided recall evidence may include a recall email screenshot and a photo of the product serial label Recall Operations must own the case when the delivered item is confirmed to be part of an active safety recall permitted remedies include refund, replacement, or returnless disposal only when explicitly authorized by Recall Operations order id EC-10458 appears in a sample case reference customer id CUS-6187 appears in a sample case reference the guidance instructs agents to document verification outcome, order inspection findings, and recall determination in the case notes Additional Information a realistic 3-page internal policy document in a corporate ecommerce operations style using reportlab a clearly labeled table listing remedy types, approval requirements, and constraints Page 3 include a section on case documentation requirements, a short example case reference block, and a decision matrix or callout box explaining when Recall Operations take ownership the example reference block visually includes the provided customer and order IDs This policy is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
